name: Dynamic Job-Scheduling for Grid Volume Rendering
aliases: Dynamic Job-Scheduling for Grid Volume Rendering — Obstacle-flag based scheduling
definition: A job-scheduling method for distributed volume rendering that dynamically updates sub-volume visibility to determine processing order, overcoming the inefficiency of static sequential scheduling where agents with varying speeds cause bottlenecks.
summary: Dynamic Job-Scheduling for Grid Volume Rendering is a distributed technique that improves efficiency by processing sub-volumes based on real-time visibility using obstacle-flags, rather than a static sequence.
